title: Library that delegates to Book
statement: Define a Book class with a parameterless constructor that starts available, a Borrow method and an Available method that returns 1 if available or 0 if not. Define a Library class that has a Book as an attribute, with a Borrow method that delegates to the book and an Available method that also delegates. Read a flag (1 to borrow, 0 to do nothing) and write whether the book is still available.

assertions.requirement: The statement asks you to solve it with classes.
